187: Now prayer is in place of sacrifice, so a person has to arrange the praise of the Master as is fitting. And if he does not arrange [it], his prayer is not a prayer. Come and see - the complete arrangement of the praise of the Holy One, blessed be He, is one who knows how to unify the Holy Name as is fitting. As, through this, he arouses the upper ones and the lower ones and draws forth blessing to all of the worlds.
